name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for omp sessions.

provider.title: Jev provider
provider.description: Which endpoint answers the Jev questions: 'typesafe' (System One, uses TYPESAFE_API_KEY) or 'openrouter' (decisions endpoint, uses OPENROUTER_API_KEY). Setting OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the environment selects 'openrouter' automatically.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: API key for the selected provider. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY from the environment.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call or result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace the built-in summary.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

baseUrl.title: System One endpoint
baseUrl.description: TypeSafe System One endpoint. Defaults to https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone.

goal.title: Ongoing task description
goal.description: Optional task description included in the state sent to Jev. Defaults to the last three user prompts.
